Pull the barbell from the floor with an extending hip drive, then receive it at the shoulders in a partial-depth catch.
Reset power clean deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Keep the bar close through the pull
Extend the hips fully before the catch
Receive the bar with elbows fast around the bar
common_faults: Catching in too deep a squat

snatch.instruction_short_text: Snatch: Pull the barbell from the floor to full extension in one continuous motion, then receive it overhead in a single catch.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the barbell on the floor with a wide grip and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Pull the barbell from the floor to full extension in one continuous motion, then receive it overhead in a single catch.
Reset snatch deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Keep the bar close through the pull
Extend the hips fully before dropping under
Lock the bar out directly overhead
common_faults: Receiving the bar out in front of the body

push_jerk.instruction_short_text: Push jerk: Dip and drive the barbell from the shoulders overhead, then re-bend the knees to receive it in a short catch.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the barbell at the shoulders in a front rack position and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Dip and drive the barbell from the shoulders overhead, then re-bend the knees to receive it in a short catch.
Reset push jerk deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Keep the dip short and vertical
Drive straight up through the drive phase
Receive the bar with locked-out arms
common_faults: Dipping forward instead of straight down
Pressing out the lockout with the arms alone
Missing the re-bend on the catch

muscle_up.instruction_short_text: Muscle-up: Pull from a dead hang through the transition, then press out above the support to a full lockout.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, gymnastics rings securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Pull from a dead hang through the transition, then press out above the support to a full lockout.
Reset muscle-up deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Pull the rings or bar to the lower chest
Drive the transition forward over the hands
common_faults: Kipping without a clean pulling phase

toes_to_bar.instruction_short_text: Toes-to-bar: Hang from the bar, then raise the feet to make contact with the bar under control and return to a full hang.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, pull up bar securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hang from the bar, then raise the feet to make contact with the bar under control and return to a full hang.
Reset toes-to-bar deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Drive from the hips, not just the legs
Return to a full hang each repetition
common_faults: Losing the brace on the return

double_under.instruction_short_text: Double-under: Turn the rope twice per jump with quick wrist rotation at the prescribed cyclical pace.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, jump rope securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Turn the rope twice per jump with quick wrist rotation at the prescribed cyclical pace.
Reset double-under deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Turn the rope from the wrists
common_faults: Turning the rope from the shoulders

rope_climb.instruction_short_text: Rope climb: Pull and step up the rope to the prescribed height, then descend under control.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, climbing rope securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Pull and step up the rope to the prescribed height, then descend under control.
Reset rope climb deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Lock the rope with the feet between pulls
Pull with the arms, stand with the legs
Descend under control, not a free slide
common_faults: Losing the foot lock between pulls

handstand_push_up.instruction_short_text: Handstand push-up: Lower the head toward the floor from an inverted support, then press back to full arm lockout.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight against a wall for support and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Lower the head toward the floor from an inverted support, then press back to full arm lockout.
Reset handstand push-up deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Brace the trunk in the inverted position
Lower under control to the prescribed depth
Press to full lockout each repetition
common_faults: Losing trunk alignment during the descent

burpee.instruction_short_text: Burpee: Drop to a chest-to-floor position, return to standing, then finish with a vertical jump.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight, open floor space securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Drop to a chest-to-floor position, return to standing, then finish with a vertical jump.
Reset burpee deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Control the drop to the floor
Drive the feet back underneath the hips
Finish with full hip and knee extension
common_faults: Stepping instead of jumping the feet back

air_squat.instruction_short_text: Air squat: Descend to the prescribed depth under bodyweight alone, then drive to full standing extension.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the bodyweight securely and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Descend to the prescribed depth under bodyweight alone, then drive to full standing extension.
Reset air squat deliberately between repetitions so range, alignment and load position remain repeatable.
coaching_cues: Track the knees with the toes
Keep pressure through the whole foot
common_faults: Losing trunk position during the descent
Shifting onto the toes and losing balance

neck_flexion_isometric.instruction_short_text: Neck flexion isometric: Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it backwards, pressing gently forwards without letting the head move.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the resistance band securely at head height and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it backwards, pressing gently forwards without letting the head move.
Release neck flexion isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.
common_faults: Tucking the chin to the chest

neck_extension_isometric.instruction_short_text: Neck extension isometric: Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it forwards, pressing gently backwards without letting the head move.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the resistance band securely at head height and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hold the head in a neutral position against the band pulling it forwards, pressing gently backwards without letting the head move.
Release neck extension isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.

neck_lateral_flexion_isometric.instruction_short_text: Neck lateral flexion isometric: Hold the head upright against the band pulling it sideways, pressing gently into the band without letting the head tilt.
instruction_detail_text: Set up the resistance band securely at head height and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Hold the head upright against the band pulling it sideways, pressing gently into the band without letting the head tilt.
Release neck lateral flexion isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.

self_resisted_neck_isometric.instruction_short_text: Self-resisted neck isometric: Press the head gently into the hand in each direction while the hand stops any movement, holding a neutral head position.
instruction_detail_text: Set up in a tall, supported posture and establish the prescribed starting position before the first repetition.
Press the head gently into the hand in each direction while the hand stops any movement, holding a neutral head position.
Release self-resisted neck isometric gradually at the end of each hold so the neck returns to neutral under control.
common_faults: Pushing hard enough to move the head
